summary: Push a tagged EE with `podman login <aap_url>` (let podman prompt for the password) and `podman push <automation_hub_url>/<ee_name>`; layer re-compression can cause 'Copying this image requires changing layer representation, which is not possible'; verify in Automation Content > Execution Environments.
questions: How do I push an execution environment to private automation hub?
Error: Copying this image requires changing layer representation, which is not possible
Why should I not pass my password to podman login on the command line?
Where do I see pushed execution environments?

answer_card.title: Pull, tag and push an EE to private hub
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
podman login registry.redhat.io
podman pull registry.redhat.io/<ee_name>:<tag>
podman tag registry.redhat.io/<ee_name>:<tag> <hub_host>/<ee_name>
podman login -u <username> <aap_url>    # let podman prompt for the password
podman push <hub_host>/<ee_name>
```
If the push fails with *changing layer representation, which is not possible*, the image is signed or digest-pinned and its layers were re-compressed. Verify in **Automation Content > Execution Environments**.
